params.initialOwner: The owner account for administrative controls.
params.price_: Price per order in USDC 6-decimal units.
params.treasury_: Treasury address that receives payment proceeds.
params.usdc_: ERC-20 token address used for payment (USDC).

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

params.newBps: New referral basis points. Maximum is 3000.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

buy(bytes32,address).notice: Pays for an order in USDC and optionally routes a referral share.

orderPaid(bytes32).notice: Tracks whether an orderId has already been paid.

price().notice: Price per order in USDC 6-decimal units (e.g., 3_000_000 = $3).

referralBps().notice: Referral share in basis points. Defaults to 2000 (20%).
